bugs.title: Relay driven on wrong pin (D7 instead of D8)
bugs.description: Line 5 defines RELAY_PIN as 7, but the spec requires the lamp relay on D8. All relay writes at lines 26, 39 and 41 therefore target D7, so D8 never follows the light reading; measured evidence shows D8 not HIGH for 600 ms at t=400 ms in the glitch scenario and 1250 ms in the nominal ramp. D8 was in the wrong state for 5450 ms across 6 interval(s), first at 400 ms: D8 was not HIGH for 600 ms while required (grace 400 ms).

bugs.title: Manual override cannot reach D8 due to relay pin mismatch
bugs.description: The manual branch at lines 55-59 calls setRelay(true), which writes to RELAY_PIN=7 (line 5) rather than D8. Consequently holding D3 LOW never forces D8 ON, as measured by D8 not HIGH for 89 ms at 1.41 s during rapid manual toggling and 1100 ms in the manual-override-then-release scenario. D8 was in the wrong state for 270 ms across 3 interval(s), first at 1.41 s: D8 was not HIGH for 89 ms while required (grace 400 ms).
